name: 14-expired-session
text:
ProxiLink
OPERATIONS CONSOLE

BLE proximity · GPS telemetry

Know what is near, in real time.

Operate registered beacons, watch live proximity bands and GPS fixes, and audit every security-relevant action across your organization — without pretending RSSI is a distance sensor.

Banded proximity

IMMEDIATE → OUT_OF_RANGE, classified server-side from smoothed RSSI.

Realtime channel

WebSocket frames for proximity, location and device status with reconnect and backoff.

Organization-scoped RBAC

USER sees its organization; ADMIN unlocks users, audit and platform settings.

OpenStreetMap only

No API keys, no vendor telemetry, dark basemap tuned for operations.

Spring Boot API · React 19 · Leaflet 1.9 · v1 contract

Operator sign-in

Authenticate with your ProxiLink account to open the cons
